system.description:
This scroll appears to be a normal scroll of one spell, and the standard restrictions apply to its use. However, 1 turn after the spell is cast, the scroll creates the same spell effect a second time, centered on the scroll or affecting the nearest creature if a recipient is part of the spell process. As with a normal spell scroll, any spell cast from it is then gone; however, another spell may be written on the scroll if it is of the same level, and the repetition effect will again apply.
Only spellcasters may use this scroll.

gm.notes: Add this item to a character's sheet, then Drag/drop the spell of your choosing to this item's Special Abilities tab. After scroll is used, a new spell may be added (per normal rules) for the same repeat effect.
